what_it_does: This paper presents an all-digital transmitter for wireless base stations that achieves exceptional energy efficiency (68% peak drain efficiency, 62% system efficiency). Unlike traditional analog transmitters that use power amplifiers, this design uses purely digital logic gates organized in carefully controlled phases to convert digital signals into radio-frequency power. The key innovation is dynamic retiming—adjusting timing on the fly to prevent glitches (unwanted electrical transients)—and a smart phase mapper that keeps the output clean across the wide bandwidth needed for modern wireless standards. At 20 watts, this design could significantly reduce the energy footprint of base stations, which currently consume 73% of wireless operators' total power.
